name: Heard and McDonald Islands
description: Heard Island and the McDonald Islands are a remote cluster of volcanic islands in the Southern Ocean, about 4,100 km south-west of Perth. Heard's glaciers cover most of the island and ice streams run down from Big Ben, a volcano whose summit, Mawson Peak, still steams and sometimes spills lava. The islands are uninhabited and free of introduced species, so huge colonies of penguins and seals breed undisturbed.
